newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil tax receipts at 9.668 bln reais in April.
newsitem.headline: Brazil tax receipts at 9.668 bln reais in April.

text.p: Brazilian federal tax receipts were 9.668 billion reais in April, up 21.62 percent from the 7.949 billion reais collected in the same month last year, Internal Revenue head Everardo Maciel said.
Maciel told reporters the April result was a 2.28 percent gain in real terms over the 9.328 billion reais collected in March.
Brazil's National Treasury was expected to release April's expenses and the Treasury's financial results for the month sometime over the next two weeks.
